request.message: एक लाल कपड़े के बैग के केवल handles को cream रंग में बदलना है। हिंदी में समझाएँ कि रंग की नई शीट और अगली फोटो का reference क्या होगा।

response.answer:
Lesson 04

प्रोडक्ट शीट को reference रखें। केवल बताए गए हिस्से का रंग बदलें; आकार, बनावट, विवरण, टेक्स्ट, लोगो, चारों दृश्य, पृष्ठभूमि और रोशनी समान रखें। हर रंग की पूरी नई शीट बनाएँ और आगे उसी का उपयोग करें।

[S1] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Colour variants (course-material) [Lesson 04; lesson_4]
• Reference: product sheet. • "Only change the colour of [part] to [colour]. Keep everything else exactly the same." • Har rang ki poori sheet banao, aage ke shots usi se.

Reviewed English translation: Use “Only change the colour… keep everything else exactly the same”. Preserve the same shape and details as the reference sheet.

[S3] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Brand ka exact colour nahi aa raha (course-material) [Lesson 04; lesson_4]
Brand ka exact colour nahi aa raha Exact shade hamesha nahi aata. 2–3 baar banao, sabse paas wala chuno. (L04)
Reviewed English translation: An exact shade is not always achievable. Generate 2–3 versions and choose the closest colour.

[S4] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Product photos (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
• Reference mein sirf product sheet. • Prompt ki pehli line: product bilkul waisa hi. • Phir scene: jagah, 2–3 cheezein, roshni, angle. Sajawat peeche, product aage.
Reviewed English translation: Use only the product sheet as reference. Start the prompt by keeping the product unchanged, then describe the place, 2–3 objects, lighting and angle. Keep decoration behind and the product in front.

[S5] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — L04 Colour Variant Sheet (course-material) [Lesson 04; lesson_4]
Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Only change the colour of [the part, e.g. all the keycaps] to [new colour, e.g. soft pastel pink]. Keep everything else exactly the same — same shape, same layout, same details, same text and logo, same four views, same background, same lighting. Output a full product sheet in the new colour.

[S6] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — L04 Wedding Gift (course-material) [Lesson 04; lesson_4]
Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it. Place it on a soft silk cloth next to an open premium gift box with gold ribbon and a few rose petals, elegant wedding gifting mood, soft warm light, [PRODUCT] sharp in the foreground, realistic real-world scale, realistic festive product photography.
Reviewed English translation: For wedding gift photos, use the product sheet and keep the product unchanged. Place it on soft silk cloth beside an open premium gift box with gold ribbon and a few rose petals, using soft warm light. Keep the product sharp in the foreground at realistic real-world scale.
